stage0005_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
Branch Member
「$$金田正太郎$$, curse you!
　We'll take that remote from you
　and make $$鉄人$$ our own fighting force!」

stage0005_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
Branch Member
「All units, advance!
　We'll corner him!」

stage0005_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
Branch Member
「What!?
　Where did that robot come from!」

stage0005_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$スズネ$$
「How should I know!
　Why does piloting a robot
　show this much skin!」

stage0005_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$n
「...Talk later!
　To keep them from reaching everyone at school,
　we'll stop them ourselves!」

stage0005_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$n
「If we can, we'll fight
　to keep them from breaking that line!」

stage0005_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$スズネ$$
「From now on, we're partners in life and death!
　Don't call me 'Sensei', use my real name!」

stage0005_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「From now on, we're partners in life and death!
　Don't call me 'Sensei', use my real name!」

stage0005_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Are you all right, $n, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

stage0005_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Something seems off about Miss $$スズネ$$...」

stage0005_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Weirdly sexy, or something like that...」

stage0005_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$クラン$$
「Enough with the nonsense,
　you girl-crazy Snipers!」

stage0005_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's save the chatter for later!
　We have to protect everyone!」

stage0005_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Robot Mafia, curse you!
　I won't let you near $$かおる$$!」

stage0005_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$オズマ$$
「The kids are right!
　Skull Leader to all units!
　Intercept the Robot Mafia!」

stage0005_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Branch Member, damn you!
　If you're after me, I'll take you on!」

stage0005_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain!
　An unidentified unit is closing on the combat zone!」

stage0005_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
???
「One who bears the sun detected.
　Commencing attack.」

stage0005_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$甲児$$
「Looks like they're pals with the Robot Mafia!」

stage0005_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$さやか$$
「But that robot and that saucer
　look nothing like the Branch robots...」

stage0005_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$厚井$$
「More than that, it's no Earth-made machine!」

stage0005_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Even so, if we leave these guys be,
　$$かおる$$ and everyone at school are in danger!」

stage0005_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Damn it!
　That sudden attack caught us off guard!」

stage0005_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Captain!
　Another ship is closing on us!」

stage0005_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ルカ$$
「It's from the Earth Federation Forces!」

stage0005_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
???
「One who bears the sun detected.
　Commencing attack.」

stage0005_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$甲児$$
「Looks like they're pals with the Robot Mafia!」

stage0005_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$さやか$$
「But that robot and that saucer
　look nothing like the Branch robots...」

stage0005_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$厚井$$
「More than that, it's no Earth-made machine!」

stage0005_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Even so, if we leave these guys be,
　$$かおる$$ and everyone at school are in danger!」

stage0005_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Damn it!
　That sudden attack caught us off guard!」

stage0005_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Captain!
　Another ship is closing on us!」

stage0005_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ルカ$$
「It's from the Earth Federation Forces!」

stage0005_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's $$カミーユ$$ piloting the blue unit!」

stage0005_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Captain $$オットー$$,
　we've got a channel open to the Macross Quarter.」

stage0005_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$オットー$$
「Uh, this is $$オットー・ミタス$$ of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$,
　Londo Bell, an independent Earth Federation unit.」

stage0005_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$オットー$$
「We too have been tracking the unidentified units
　you're engaged with. We'll lend our support now.」

stage0005_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This is Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$,
　captain of the Macross Quarter.
　We appreciate your ship's assistance.」

stage0005_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Huh, their captain
　seems like kind of an unreliable old guy.」

stage0005_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$マオ$$
「Still, Londo Bell is
　an elite unit of the Earth Federation Forces.
　Let's see what they've got.」

stage0005_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$エマ$$
「$$ファ$$!
　Go support that blue robot over there!」

stage0005_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ファ$$
「This is $$ファ・ユイリィ$$ in the $$メタス$$.
　I'm here to back you up.」

stage0005_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Skull Leader to all units!
　Save the questions about the Unknowns for later!」

stage0005_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Don't let the Robot Mafia or Unknowns through!
　Work with Londo Bell and take the enemy down!」

stage0005_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ミーナ#120$$
「They threw that many at us and still lost,
　so I'd think the Robot Mafia will settle down now...」

stage0005_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ラム$$
「The Unknowns are the real problem.」

stage0005_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$キャシー$$
「From what we could see,
　the Robot Mafia and the Unknowns
　seemed to have no connection...」

stage0005_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ボビー$$
「So they're new invaders, is that it!?」

stage0005_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...We need something to confirm that.
　Once all units are recovered, let's trade
　information with Londo Bell.」

stage0005_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Also, tell Ensign $$アルト$$ and the other students
　to get back to their hike right away,
　given the effect on the people around them.」

stage0005_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$n
「Damn it!
　I won't let them go any further!」

stage0005_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$スズネ$$
「No good!
　The enemy's heading for everyone!」

stage0005_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$n
「$$ジェニオン$$!
　Even with your power, I still can't protect anyone!?」

stage0005_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Words... just ran through me...?）

stage0005_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（That feeling just now... Captain $$アムロ$$...?
　No, it feels rawer than that...）

stage0005_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Is there someone nearby who can feel what I feel...?）

stage0005_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$n
「If you're scared, get out.
　I'll fight alone.」

stage0005_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$n
「There's no need to push yourself.
　Not fighting at all would obviously be better.」

stage0005_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm sorry, $n...
　I... didn't have the resolve I needed...」

stage0005_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I... might just be dead weight to you...!
　But I swear I won't ever run away!」

stage0005_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$n
「...Understood.
　But I swear I'll protect you, Miss $$スズネ$$...!」

stage0005_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$甲児$$
「You're telling me evil aliens showed up again!」

stage0005_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$甲児$$
「But too bad for you!
　As long as Mazinger and I are around,
　don't think you can do as you please on Earth!」

stage0005_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Why is it that so many guys
　who come from space are bad news!」

stage0005_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Get ready, you jerk!
　You're the ones who started this fight,
　so that's why we're fighting back!」

stage0005_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I don't know why you're after $$鉄人$$,
　but if you're the kind who'll put everyone
　in danger, I won't go easy on you!」

stage0005_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Go, $$鉄人$$!
　Take down the Robot Mafia and the mystery enemy!」

stage0005_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$アルト$$
「I got used to fighting aliens during the $$再世戦争$$!」

stage0005_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$アルト$$
「Come at me if you dare!
　I'll knock you all out of the sky one by one!」

stage0005_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$宗介$$
「Whether the enemy is human or not,
　if it obstructs the mission, I will eliminate it.」

stage0005_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$宗介$$
「Preventing your breakthrough is my mission!」

stage0005_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$n
「But that doesn't change that you're my enemy too...!
　Don't think you can get through here!」

stage0005_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$, going in now!」

stage0005_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$リディ$$
「I'll leave the timing to you, $$カミーユ$$.
　You have more real combat experience,
　and more time in variable mobile suits than I do.」

stage0005_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then, with two $$リゼル$$s in combination...!」

stage0005_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$リディ$$
（A chance I've been given...!
　I'll make the most of it, no matter what!）

stage0005_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$カツ$$
「I was only supposed to assist $$カミーユ$$,
　and suddenly I'm in real combat...!」

stage0005_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$エマ$$
「You've come this far, so steel yourself, $$カツ$$!」

stage0005_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$カツ$$
「I know that!
　Whatever we're up against, I'll pull my weight too!」

stage0005_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$オットー$$
「Fighting Neo Zeon after being sent to Earth, fine.
　But a mafia and mystery aliens too...」

stage0005_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain, give orders before you complain.」

stage0005_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$オットー$$
「I know that!
　Londo Bell can't afford to fall behind
　an irregular unit of the Frontier fleet!」
